mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(pw.point_balance, 0) AS pointBalance FROM user_tbl AS user LEFT OUTER JOIN point_wallet_tbl AS pw ON user.user_id = pw.user_id WHERE user.user_id = #{userId} AND user.user_status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT ec.challenge_id AS challengeId , ecu.user_challenge_id AS userChallengeId , ecu.user_id AS userId , IFNULL(ecu.current_level, 1) AS currentLevel , IFNULL(ecu.current_target, 0) AS currentTarget , IFNULL(ecl.required_exp, 1000) AS requiredExp , IFNULL(ecl.reward_point, 1000) AS rewardPoint , ecl.challenge_level_id AS challengeLevelId , ecl.level AS level , ecu.exp AS exp , ecu.status AS status , ecu.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM event_challenge_tbl AS ec LEFT OUTER JOIN event_challenge_user_tbl AS ecu ON ec.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id AND ecu.user_id = #{userId} LEFT OUTER JOIN event_challenge_level_tbl AS ecl ON ec.challenge_id = ecl.challenge_id AND ecl.level = IFNULL(ecu.current_level, 1) WHERE NOW() BETWEEN ec.start_date AND ec.end_date AND ecu.user_challenge_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ecu.current_level DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_participation_tbl (event_id, user_id, participated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO event_attendance_tbl (event_id, user_id, participated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO event_reward_receive_tbl (event_id, reward_id, user_id, received_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{rewardId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.update: INSERT INTO point_transaction_tbl ( point_wallet_id, transaction_type, point_amount, reason_type, created_at ) SELECT w.point_wallet_id, 'EARN', r.reward_point, 'EVENT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM point_wallet_tbl AS w, event_reward_tbl AS r WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND r.reward_id = #{rewardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_challenge_user_tbl (user_id, challenge_id, current_level, current_target, exp, status, updated_at) SELECT #{userId}, ec.challenge_id, 1, 0, 0, 'PROCESS', NOW() FROM event_challenge_tbl AS ec WHERE NOW() BETWEEN ec.start_date AND ec.end_date AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_challenge_user_tbl ecu WHERE ecu.user_id = #{userId} AND ecu.challenge_id = ec.challenge_id) ORDER BY ec.challenge_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE event_challenge_user_tbl AS ecu INNER JOIN event_challenge_level_tbl AS ecl ON ecu.challenge_id = ecl.challenge_id AND ecu.current_level = ecl.level SET ecu.exp = ecu.exp - ecl.required_exp, ecu.current_level = ecu.current_level + 1, ecu.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ecu.user_id = #{userId} AND ecu.exp >= ecl.required_exp AND ecu.status = 'PROCESS'

UPDATE event_challenge_user_tbl SET status = 'REWARDED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'COMPLETE' AND challenge_id IN ( SELECT ec.challenge_id FROM event_challenge_tbl ec WHERE NOW() BETWEEN ec.start_date AND ec.end_date )
mapper.select: # SELECT COUNT(*) # FROM ( # SELECT event_id, user_id FROM event_participation_tbl # WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(participated_at) = CURDATE() # UNION ALL # SELECT event_id, user_id FROM event_attendance_tbl # WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(participated_at) = CURDATE() # ) AS today_part

select a.event_id, a.event_name, a.event_desc, a.event_type, a.event_status, a.event_img_name, a.event_target, a.event_level, a.event_daily_limit_count, a.start_at, a.end_at,
b.reward_id, b.reward_point, b.reward_exp,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.event_id = a.event_id ) AS currentTargetCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.event_id = a.event_id ) >= a.event_target AS completed,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.user_id = #{userId} AND err.event_id = a.event_id ) AS rewardReceived,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_user_tbl eu WHERE eu.user_id = #{userId} AND eu.event_id = a.event_id ) AS joined
from event_tbl a left join event_reward_tbl b on a.event_id = b.event_id WHERE a.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' ORDER BY a.created_at desc;

select a.event_id, a.event_name, a.event_desc, a.event_type, a.event_status, a.event_img_name, a.event_target, a.event_level, a.event_daily_limit_count, a.start_at, a.end_at,
b.reward_id, b.reward_point, b.reward_exp,
(a.event_daily_limit_count > 0 AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.event_id = a.event_id AND DATE(ep.participated_at) = CURDATE() ) >= a.event_daily_limit_count ) AS isDailyLimitReached,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = a.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(ea.participated_at) = CURDATE() ) AS todayAttendanceCompleted,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.user_id = #{userId} AND ea.event_id = a.event_id ) AS currentTargetCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.user_id = #{userId} AND ea.event_id = a.event_id ) >= a.event_target AS completed,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.user_id = #{userId} AND err.event_id = a.event_id ) AS rewardReceived
from event_tbl a left join event_reward_tbl b on a.event_id = b.event_id WHERE a.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' ORDER BY a.created_at desc;

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId , e.event_name AS eventName , e.event_desc AS eventDesc , e.event_type AS eventType , e.event_img_name AS eventImgName , er.reward_id AS rewardId , err.recv_id AS recvId , DATE_FORMAT(err.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS receivedAt , IFNULL(er.reward_point,0) AS rewardPoint , IFNULL(er.reward_exp,0) AS rewardExp FROM event_reward_receive_tbl AS err INNER JOIN event_tbl AS e ON err.event_id = e.event_id LEFT OUTER JOIN event_reward_tbl AS er ON err.event_id = er.event_id AND err.reward_id = er.reward_id WHERE err.user_id = #{userId} AND e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND DATE_FORMAT(err.received_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY err.received_at DESC
